purpose: Define explicit idempotency keys scoped to exact operation/target/requester contexts so retries can identify equivalent effect requests without merging unrelated executions.

topics.name: Idempotency Key
topics.purpose: Define explicit idempotency keys scoped to exact operation/target/requester contexts so retries can identify equivalent effect requests without merging unrelated executions.

semantics.key_rule: Idempotency key is explicit request metadata.
semantics.scope_rule: Key scope includes exact operation and target plus declared requester/domain scope.
semantics.equivalence_rule: Same key is equivalent only under the exact declared scope/profile.
semantics.execution_rule: Idempotency key does not replace request/execution identities.
semantics.result_rule: Previously accepted result/effect may be returned/referenced according to operation profile.
semantics.collision_rule: Same key with non-equivalent payload is conflict/hard-fail.

invariants.rule: Definitions, requests, validation evidence, authorization decisions and concrete executions remain separate identities; only an explicit validated and authorized dispatcher path may create effects.

hard_gates.condition: idempotency key reused as execution identity
expired key silently treated permanently valid

references.purpose: Requests may carry exact idempotency keys.
